analyst_view.overall: Atlético Madrid (23rd, 4 points) and Viking (22nd, 4 points) sit one place apart and both need points to stay in the play-off places; it is the clubs' first meeting. Atlético have been short of goals, losing their last Champions League game 2-0 to Bayern, and played Getafe in La Liga on Sunday without Ademola Lookman (high-grade knee sprain from Nigeria duty), Marc Pubill (ankle, from Spain duty) and Cristian Romero (muscle injury, five games missed already); the numbers now count Lookman and Pubill, and Romero's absence is already in their recent form. Viking beat Sabah 4-1 for their first Champions League win, have scored in 12 European games in a row but have won only two of their last 13 European away games, and are in a tight Eliteserien title race with Bodø/Glimt with more league games to come. No referee has been named yet. Since my last view Lookman has entered the numbers, so I drop my cut on Atlético's attack and stay with the numbers everywhere.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, 2.6 of them Atlético's, and now take Lookman and Pubill off (about -2.6% each on Atlético, +6% for Viking with Pubill out at the back) plus a little for Atlético's poor scoring lately. Last time I trimmed for Lookman because the numbers did not know about him; now they do, so that cut goes. Romero has been out for five games, so his absence is already in Atlético's form, and I stay at 3.9.

corners.text: The numbers expect 12 corners, over 8 of them Atlético's, as they should have most of the ball at home against a side that has won only two of its last 13 European away games. Viking's busy recent corner count already adds about 4% to their side. Lookman's absence changes who runs down the wings more than how often Atlético attack, so I stay at 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.5 cards and already take a little off both sides for their recent card counts. No referee is named yet, there is no rivalry, and Viking are an open, attacking side rather than a cynical one. Nothing I found points either way, so I stay at 3.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.8 shots, 21 of them Atlético's, and already add about 13% to Viking's side for their recent shooting against a leaky Atlético. My earlier small cut for Lookman is gone because the numbers now list him out. Atlético at home still have Julián Álvarez, Sørloth and David to shoot, so I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target and already take 5% off Atlético for their poor accuracy lately. Lookman is now in the numbers' missing list, so I no longer trim for him. Viking have scored in every European game for a year and Atlético have not had a goalless Champions League game in 42, which fits the numbers' picture, so I stay at 10.8.
